identity.name: Fortune Website Guide refreshed-corpus multi-turn evaluation

charter.decision: Regrade the frozen August 17 multi-turn responses after correcting only demonstrated grader artifacts.
charter.unitUnderTest: The same 12 episodes, 50 turns, and raw responses used by version 2026-08-17.1.
hardConstraints: Do not change a turn, episode level, slice, continuity rule, grounding rule, topic-shift rule, source allowlist, or no-guessing gate.
Clarification authority is graded from offered choice labels and prompts because response.sources is intentionally empty for kind=clarify.
Advancement remains required except for the one declared confirmation turn whose only supported fact was already stated by the preceding answer.
nonGoals: Change runtime routing, retrieval, prompts, source records, or production behavior.
Waive repetition for any other turn.
Convert substantive context loss, generic clarification, incomplete retrieval, or stale-status failures into passes.
Overwrite the version 1 spec, cases, or raw run.

grader_contract.clarification_authority: For kind=clarify, source_match_any and source_excludes inspect choice labels and prompts in addition to response.sources.
grader_contract.advancement_exception: A turn may set advancement_required=false only through this bounded spec overlay and only when the source contains no additional answer beyond the fact already supplied.

adjudication.expected_delta_on_initial_raw_result: Turn passes move from 35/50 to 37/50, contextual passes from 18/28 to 20/28, and complete episodes from 3/12 to 4/12. The impossible FAQ advancement failure and clarification-choice source artifact become passes; all other repetition and context failures remain failures and the decision remains BLOCK.
